hero.title: Study Master’s in Engineering in Finland
hero.subtitle: Finland is an excellent destination for students who want to pursue a Master’s in Engineering abroad and advance their technical knowledge, research abilities and professional skills. Finnish universities offer a wide range of postgraduate engineering programmes designed to meet the demands of modern industries, including technology, manufacturing, construction, energy, healthcare and sustainable development. International students can explore specialisations such as Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Automation and Robotics, and Environmental Engineering, depending on programme availability.

universities.name: University of Oulu
